newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France pilots postpone strike.
newsitem.headline: Air France pilots postpone strike.

text.p: Air France pilots unions decided on Friday to delay a four-day strike planned to start from March 23, which could have cost the airline one billion francs.

"Seventy percent of the pilots at the general assembly voted for a delay in the strike," said an Air France spokeswoman after unions met on Friday to review the strike call following a resignation threat by chairman Christian Blanc if the stoppage went ahead.
